headers.title: Headers and constants
headers.text: The site as Referer on every picture; COVER_ATTR the image attribute that held a real address on the home page.

getPopular.title: Popular
getPopular.text: /most-viewed?page=N, the .manga-poster cards with the title in .manga-name a.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: .manga-name, the poster image, .description, the .anisc-info rows for authors and status, the genre links.

getChapterList.title: Chapters
getChapterList.text: Finds the title's numeric id and asks /ajax/manga/reading-list/<id>; the reply's html holds .chapter-item rows with data-number. This layout prints no dates.

getPageList.title: Pages
getPageList.text: Finds the chapter's reading id and asks /ajax/image/list/chap/<id>; each .iv-card's data-url is a picture. Shuffled pictures are returned as they come.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One request with the site as Referer, the shared card parser, absolute addresses, the cover attribute chain and the first number of a text.
